title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the net radial force on the electron.

title: Charge Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and express the charge density of the electron beam as rho = -en.

title: Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define the Lorentz factor gamma = 1/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2).

title: Force Components
description: Optional Criteria: The student may detail the contributions of electric and magnetic forces to the net radial force.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final expression for force are consistent with Newtons.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expression for the radial force.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as 2 and pi, are included in the final answer.
